query: I have a 65-year-old female patient. Among hospitalized women aged 60–70, what's the IQR (days) of atorvastatin 40–80 mg prescriptions?
final_sql: SELECT (percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY duration) - percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY duration)) AS interquartile_range FROM atorvastatin_prescriptions;
